note: Generated by scripts/studio-words.mjs from web/studio/parts/*-words.js. Do not edit: run the script.

vars.helper: the person who set up your site

about.aliasFix.text: An old address in this post can't be used. {helper} can fix it in the file.

add.asWrittenHelp.text: Everything exactly as it's saved. Turn this off to see cards again.

add.detailsNote.text: Everything here writes ordinary Markdown into content/posts/{file}. Pieces are checked and written by {product} (POST /admin/api/pieces), so the file holds exactly what the build reads.

add.nothingHelp.text: Try another word, or close this and keep writing.

add.slashTip.text: Tip: type / on an empty line to add something.

add.whereEnd.text: It goes at the end of {box}.

add.whereStart.text: It goes at the start of {box}.

add.wordsHelp.text: Leave an empty line between paragraphs. For a list, start each line with a dash (-). Photos, tips and tables show as cards: change them with their buttons.

bluesky.nameError.text: Type your Bluesky name, like yourname.bsky.social.

card.asWritten.text: Change it in the words as written

card.cantChange.text: This one can't be changed here. {helper} can.

card.elsewhere.text: This photo is on another website.

card.unclosed.text: Part of this post is open as written

card.unclosedLine.text: A code block starting on line {line} never ends.

card.unclosedWhy.text: So nothing in it gets moved around.

cards.notSetUp.text: {helper} needs to finish setting them up. Your site works the same without them.

check.allCaps.text: This is all in capital letters, which can read like shouting.

check.emptyAddress.text: A link doesn't go anywhere yet.

check.emptyLink.text: A link has no words, so no one can tell where it goes.

check.headingSkip.text: This heading is smaller than it should be after the one before it.

check.html.text: Line {line} has an HTML tag. It is kept and shown as written.

check.insecure.text: This web address starts with http://. Most sites also work with https://, which is safer.

check.longParagraph.text: This paragraph is {count} words long. Shorter ones are easier to read on a phone.

check.photoDescription.text: A photo has no description, so people who can't see it won't know what it shows.

check.vagueLink.text: The link “{words}” doesn't say where it goes. Words that name the place are easier to follow.

common.catchesUp.text: Your public site catches up when {helper} sends it out.

common.keepsHappening.text: Try again, and if it keeps happening, tell {helper}.

copy.notReady.text: Your blog can't make a copy for it right now. Try another, or tell {helper}.

decorations.betweenOff.text: The look {product} wears while the calendar is off.

decorations.byItself.text: {product} changes by itself on the days below.

decorations.calendarOff.text: {product} wears {theme} every day. The calendar is off.

decorations.noSeasons.text: Add one, like Christmas from December 1 to January 6, and {product} changes by itself.

decorations.putUpEarly.text: {product} is decorated for {theme}, put up early. It stays up through {until}.

decorations.whenYouSave.text: When you save, {product} wears {theme} every day. Your seasons are kept for when you turn this back on.

did.cantMoveDown.text: This is already at the end.

did.cantMoveUp.text: This is already at the top.

did.cantUndo.text: This changed since, so it can't be undone here.

did.movedTop.text: Moved up. It's now at the top.

form.addThisText.text: You filled it in but didn't add it.

form.badAddress.text: That needs to be a web address starting with https://, or one of your posts.

form.badEmail.text: That doesn't look like an email address.

form.badVideo.text: That isn't a YouTube or Vimeo link. Copy it from Share under the video.

form.cantAddYet.text: {product} can't add this yet. {helper} can update it.

form.checkHelp.text: Check what you filled in against the help under each box.

form.keepChangesText.text: You changed it but didn't press Done.

form.linkAddress.text: That needs to be a web address, starting with https://.

form.mapLinkHelp.text: In OpenStreetMap or Google Maps, find the place, then copy the address from the top of the page.

form.mapNone.text: That link doesn't say where the place is.

form.mapShort.text: That's a short link, which doesn't say where the place is. Open it, then copy the long address from the top of the page.

form.moved.text: This changed while the form was open. Close it and try again.

form.needColumn.text: Give at least one column a name.

form.needDescribe.text: Describe the photo so everyone knows what it shows.

form.needHttps.text: A full web address, starting with https://.

form.needThings.text: Write something on each line, or take the empty ones out.

form.needVideoAbout.text: Say what the video is about.

form.noAnswer.text: {product} didn't answer, so it isn't in yet. What you filled in is kept.

form.noTags.text: This can't hold code like <b>. Take out the part with < and >.

form.noTicks.text: This can't have three ` marks in a row.

form.offMap.text: That map link points somewhere off the map. Copy it again.

form.penBad.text: That isn't a CodePen address. It looks like https://codepen.io/name/pen/…

form.photoNoSignal.text: Your photos show here when there's a signal.

form.photoNone.text: There are no photos on your site yet. Add one above.

form.photoOnSite.text: Or use one already on your site

form.postsNeedSignal.text: Your posts show here when there's a signal.

form.quizNeedAnswers.text: Fill in each answer, or take it out.

form.quizNoLinks.text: A question for readers can't hold links or photos.

form.runNeed.text: Fill in title, what to try and code.

form.runNeedExpected.text: A challenge needs its expected result.

form.runTodo.text: A challenge's starter code needs a TODO comment.

form.runWebParts.text: Web code needs a ---html, ---css or ---js part.

form.seeItNote.text: Only you can see this. Nothing is added until you press Add it.

form.shortened.text: Shortened to {max} letters, the most it can hold.

form.signedOut.text: You're signed out, so it isn't in yet. What you filled in is kept. Press Try again to sign in.

form.tooMuch.text: That's too much to add at once. Split it into two.

form.videoAboutHelp.text: Said before it plays, for people who can't see it.

form.videoLinkHelp.text: Copy it from Share under the video.

form.waiting.text: Waiting for a signal. What you filled in is kept here. Press Add it when you have one.

home.filesVanish.text: This server doesn't keep its files when it restarts. Ask {helper} to fix that.

home.notUpdated.text: Your site couldn't be updated. Your work is saved. Let {helper} know; the details are under Your site.

install.signInFirst.text: You'll sign in once more from the new icon, so have your password handy. If you don't know it, ask {helper} first.

item.abstractAbout.text: The short summary research posts start with.

item.buttonAbout.text: Takes readers to a page, an email or a phone number.

item.checklistAbout.text: Things to tick off, like what to buy.

item.codeAbout.text: A code block with a language, a title and highlighted lines.

item.codepenAbout.text: A pen shown in the post, by its address.

item.compareAbout.text: Two photos side by side, like the room before and after.

item.faqAbout.text: Questions readers ask. Each opens to show your answer.

item.footnoteAbout.text: A numbered note at the bottom of the post.

item.headingAbout.text: A short title that starts a new part of your post.

item.hoursAbout.text: The days and hours you're open.

item.linkAbout.text: To one of your posts or another website.

item.photoAbout.text: One of your photos, with a few words about it.

item.quizAbout.text: A quick quiz: readers pick an answer and find out if they're right.

item.referencesAbout.text: The list of works you cite, at the end.

item.runnableAbout.text: An example or a challenge readers edit and run.

item.tableAbout.text: Rows and columns, like sizes and prices.

item.tipAbout.text: A box that stands out, like “Book a week ahead.”

job.newerVersion.text: This job was saved by a newer version of your blog's pages. Reload to send it. If it still says this, tell {helper}.

kinds.collectionsAbout.text: A collection gathers posts on one page, like all your posts on one topic. Put a post in one from the post itself.

kinds.collectionsEmpty.text: A collection gathers posts on one page, like all your posts on one topic.

kinds.pagesAbout.text: Pages stay put, like About or Contact. Posts come and go by date.

look.notAccepted.text: Your site's settings didn't accept these choices. Your choices are still here; try a different one, or tell {helper}.

notify.canTurnOn.text: {helper} can turn them on. Your blog works the same without them.

notify.nameHelp.text: So you can tell them apart, like Work phone.

notify.nameMissing.text: Give it a name, like Work phone.

paste.kept.text: Pasted. Headings, bold and links kept. Fonts and colours left out.

paste.photoLeftMany.text: {count} photos were left out because they have no description. Put them in with Put a photo in.

paste.photoLeftOne.text: 1 photo was left out because it has no description. Put it in with Put a photo in.

photo.altHelp.text: For people who can't see it, like “A red front door with a wreath”.

quote.hostChose.text: {helper} chose this, so it can't be changed here.

ready.blockedNote.text: Fix the things under Needs fixing first. Your words are kept.

ready.blocks.text: {count} things need fixing before your post can go up.

ready.build.text: Something in this post stops {product} from building it. Tell {helper}.

ready.cardCaption.text: How your post looks when it's shared

ready.cardFirstLines.text: The first lines of your post.

ready.cardHelp.text: What Facebook, text messages and other apps show when someone shares it.

ready.cardLongSummary.text: Google usually shows about 160 letters; this summary has {count}. The rest may be cut off.

ready.cardNoPicture.text: No picture. Add a cover photo and shared links show it.

ready.cardNoSummary.text: No summary, so your first lines are used.

ready.cardPictureFailed.text: The picture couldn't be shown here. It may still show when shared.

ready.cardRough.text: Roughly how it looks. The real card shows when you have a signal.

ready.cardRoughFixFirst.text: Roughly how it looks. The real card shows once the things above are fixed.

ready.cardRoughHeading.text: Roughly how it looks in a search or a shared link

ready.coverDescription.text: Your cover photo has no description, so people who can't see it won't know what it shows.

ready.coverFileName.text: Your cover photo's description looks like a file name (“{name}”). Say what it shows instead.

ready.detailsCardRows.text: OpenGraph type: {type}. X card: {card}. Image: {image}. Page: {url}.

ready.detailsCertify.text: These checks find some source problems. They don't certify WCAG conformance.

ready.detailsPageList.text: Colour contrast, visible focus, keyboard order, zoom and reflow to 320 px, reduced motion, target size, layouts at phone and desktop widths, and things from other sites.

ready.hardToUse.text: Something here may be hard for some readers to use.

ready.hintDepth.text: {count} words; 150 or more when the topic needs explaining.

ready.hintNoOpening.text: No opening paragraph before the first heading or list.

ready.hintOpening.text: The opening paragraph is {count} letters; 40–350 answers the question early.

ready.hintSource.text: No link to an outside source.

ready.hintSubtitle.text: Line under the title is {count} letters; 160 or fewer reads as one line.

ready.media.text: Your video or sound: if there's talking, captions or a written version help people who can't hear it.

ready.noName.text: {product} doesn't have your name yet, so the post doesn't say who wrote it. Tell {helper}.

ready.noSignal.text: Waiting for a signal to check the rest. What's here was checked on this {phone}.

ready.noTags.text: No tags yet. A tag puts it with your other posts on the same topic.

ready.nothingHelp.text: Checks catch some things, not everything.

ready.oneBlock.text: 1 thing needs fixing before your post can go up.

ready.oneSuggestion.text: 1 suggestion. It doesn't stop you publishing.

ready.otherSite.text: Something from another website is shown in your post. Check that it works without a mouse.

ready.photoFileName.text: A photo's description looks like a file name (“{name}”). Say what it shows instead.

ready.previewMany.text: {count} things to look at before you publish.

ready.previewOne.text: 1 thing to look at before you publish.

ready.someDidntRun.text: Some checks didn't run, so this list may be missing things. You can still publish.

ready.suggestions.text: {count} suggestions. None of them stop you publishing.

ready.table.text: Your table: check that the top row names each column, like Weight and Time.

ready.titleLong.text: Google shows about 65 letters of a title; this one has {count}. The rest may be cut off.

ready.tooLong.text: This post is too long to check all at once. You can still publish.

recipe.askAddName.text: This recipe doesn't say who wrote it. Ask {helper} to add your name.

recipe.numberedStep.text: Step {n} starts with its own number. Take it out; {product} numbers the steps.

review.blocking.text: Needs fixing before it can go up ({count})

review.blockingHelp.text: {product} won't publish the post with these. They can't be marked as checked.

review.cantRead.text: {product} couldn't read this post to check it. Tell {helper}.

review.counts.text: Found by a check: {detected}. Might need a look: {potential}. Only you can check: {review}.

review.detectedHelp.text: Fix them, or mark them as checked if nothing needs to change. They don't stop you publishing.

review.didMark.text: Marked as checked. It stays on the list and in the count.

review.didntRun.text: The research checks didn't run. A research post waits until they do.

review.gateRefuses.text: This can't be marked as checked: {product} refuses it, so it has to be fixed.

review.gateRefusesWhenPublished.text: This can't be marked as checked: once the post is published, {product} refuses this citation, so fix it instead. Until then it only warns.

review.gateWithholds.text: This can't be marked as checked. The comparison stays off your site until you look at the place and approve it again.

review.intro.text: These are prompts from your research checks, not verdicts: nothing here says the post is true or complete. Only what {product} refuses stops publishing.

review.markChanged.text: This list was changed on another computer. Here it is again; mark it again if you still need to.

review.markNoSignal.text: Waiting for a signal. Nothing was marked.

review.marked.text: You marked this as checked. It stays on the list until it changes.

review.markedStale.text: You marked an earlier version of this as checked; it has changed since. Mark it again if it still needs no change.

review.marksUnreadable.text: Marks can't be read right now, so none are shown or saved. Tell {helper}.

review.needsReviewHelp.text: Check them against your sources. They don't stop you publishing.

review.nothing.text: The research checks found nothing for this post. Checks can't see everything.

route.approximateHelp.text: A drawing with no map and no place names. Someone who knows the area may recognise where it starts.

route.appsHelp.text: In AllTrails, Strava or Gaia GPS, use Export or Share and choose GPX.

route.askExactText.text: Anyone can download it and see exactly where you started and finished. Times and your app's details are taken out first.

route.askUseText.text: You chose a file but didn't add it.

route.chooseAgain.text: Choose your route file again to show it this way.

route.climb.text: Show a drawing of the climb

route.comesOff.text: Your route file comes off your site when you press Update.

route.detailsCleaned.text: Cleaned file: {size}, {points} track points with position and height. Removed: times, waypoints, routes, names, descriptions, links, the app's details and extensions.

route.detailsPoints.text: Points read: {points}; kept for the drawing: {kept}; track parts: {parts}.

route.detailsWhere.text: Held privately in .openblog/pending-tracks/held/ while the post is a draft or scheduled; at {address} once it is live. Staged copies are kept privately for up to a day.

route.didntGo.text: Your route file didn't go with the post. Choose it again in Your route.

route.drawTrimmed.text: Drawing of your route as readers see it, without the first and last {trim}

route.drawWhole.text: Drawing of your route as readers see it, the whole route

route.exactHelp.text: Readers can download your route file and see exactly where you started and finished.

route.expired.text: Your route file waited too long. Choose it again in Your route, then save.

route.howMuch.text: How much of the route readers see

route.lede.text: Choose the route file from your hiking app or watch. It stays on this {phone}: only the numbers and a drawing go to {product}.

route.lineExact.text: Route: readers can download your exact route.

route.lineHidden.text: Route: readers see the numbers only.

route.lineTrimmed.text: Route: readers see a drawing without the first and last {trim}.

route.lineTrimmedPlain.text: Route: readers see a drawing without the first and last part.

route.lineWhole.text: Route: readers see a drawing of the whole route.

route.noRoute.text: That file has no route in it. Some apps save only places; choose the one with your route.

route.noTimes.text: No times in the file, so How long stays as you wrote it.

route.notGpx.text: That isn't a route file. Choose the file that ends in .gpx.

route.replaces.text: This replaces the distance, climb and time in your post.

route.sendEmpty.text: That route file is empty. Choose it again.

route.sendTooBig.text: That route file is too big for {product} ({max} MB at most). Show less of the route, or ask {helper}.

route.sendUnreadable.text: {product} couldn't read that route file. Choose another, or show less of the route.

route.tooBig.text: That route file is too big ({size}). Files up to 10 MB work.

route.tooManyPoints.text: That route has too many points to read here. Shorten it in your hiking app, or share a simpler copy.

route.tooShort.text: Your route is too short to leave that much off each end. Choose less, or don't show it.

route.trimmed.text: The shape, without where it starts and ends

route.trimmedHelp.text: A drawing with no map and no place names. The first and last part are left off, and so is anywhere it comes close to where it starts or ends.

route.undone.text: Undone. Your route is as it was.

route.unreadable.text: That file couldn't be opened. Choose it again.

route.unsafe.text: That file has something in it besides a route, so it wasn't read.

route.waitsPrivate.text: Your route file waits, private, until your post is on your site.

route.waitsSignal.text: Waiting for a signal to send your route file. The numbers and drawing are in. It sends while this page is open.

share.tellOrSkip.text: Tell {helper}, or choose Don't share it.

social.canTurnOn.text: {helper} can turn it on. Your site works the same without it.

social.facebookNoPage.text: Facebook didn't show any Page you can post to. You need to run the Page. If you do, ask {helper} to add you to its Facebook app.

social.noPlaces.text: {helper} needs to add Facebook or another place first.

social.orgsTruncated.text: LinkedIn sent only some of your company pages. If yours isn't here, tell {helper}.

social.pagesTruncated.text: Facebook sent only some of your Pages. If yours isn't here, tell {helper}.

social.signInAgain.text: {service} will ask you to sign in. Use the {service} account you used the first time. If {service} shows someone else's name, tell {helper}.

trip.areaAddress.text: “{area}” looks like a street address. Use an area name instead, like a park or a mountain range.

trip.exactRoute.text: Readers can see exactly where you started and finished. Make sure it doesn't show a home, a campsite, or a place where rare plants or animals live.

trip.noArea.text: Add where you went, as an area that's safe to share, like a park or a mountain range.

trip.noConditions.text: Add the conditions: weather, trail, water, what you saw.

trip.noDistance.text: Add your route, or fill in the distance, so readers know how far you went.

undo.askHelp.text: There's a new {one} with that name now. Ask {helper} to help bring this one back.

undo.mayFind.text: “{title}” can't come back from here. {helper} may still find it.

write.collectionHelp.text: Put it with others, like all your posts on one topic.

youtube.chapterHelp.text: Chapters are lines in your words that start with a time, like “0:00 Getting started”. The first starts at 0:00, and YouTube needs at least three, each 10 seconds or longer.

youtube.chapters.text: {count} chapters, from the lines in your words that start with a time.

youtube.copyRefused.text: Select the words and copy them.

youtube.descriptionBrackets.text: YouTube doesn't allow < or > in the description. Take them out of the summary, the chapters or the AI note.

youtube.descriptionCopied.text: Description copied. Paste it into YouTube.

youtube.descriptionTooLong.text: These words are too long for YouTube, which takes 5,000 at most, counting the chapters. Shorten the summary.

youtube.detailsCli.text: Check or write out the full release with `openblog video {slug}`; uploading is in docs/video-production.md §Upload an approved release.

youtube.detailsLocal.text: Worked out on this page with the engine's rules; the server's copy shows when there is a signal.

youtube.durationMissing.text: Add how long the video is, so the last chapter can be checked.

youtube.firstNotZero.text: The first chapter has to start at 0:00.

youtube.keepPrivate.text: Keep the video private on YouTube until this post is on your site.

youtube.lede.text: Paste these into YouTube when you put your video up. Nothing here changes your video.

youtube.noAddress.text: Save your post to add its address.

youtube.noChapters.text: No chapters. That's fine; YouTube shows the video without them.

youtube.oneChapter.text: 1 chapter, from the line in your words that starts with a time.

youtube.other.text: YouTube may not take these words as they are.

youtube.outOfOrder.text: The chapters' times have to go up, one after the other.

youtube.rowProblem.text: Words for YouTube: 1 thing YouTube won't take

youtube.rowProblems.text: Words for YouTube: {count} things YouTube won't take

youtube.rowReady.text: Words for YouTube: ready to copy · {chapters}

youtube.tagsTooLong.text: YouTube takes up to 500 letters of tags; yours have {count}. Use fewer or shorter tags.

youtube.titleBrackets.text: YouTube doesn't allow < or > in a title. Take them out of the title.

youtube.titleMissing.text: Give your post a title first.

youtube.titleTooLong.text: YouTube takes titles of up to 100 letters; this one has {count}. Shorten the title.

youtube.tooFew.text: YouTube shows chapters only when there are at least 3. Add more, or take the times out.

youtube.tooShort.text: Each chapter has to be at least 10 seconds long, the last one too.
